# Item Distribution
1. Any high-value items made using the circuit imprinter and distributed to crew must be recorded and approved by the Research Director. Information that must be recorded includes the distributor, the item's name(s) and the recipient. Examples of high-value items: Lathes, Artifact/Anomaly boards, AI lawboards.
2. The RD can designate certain items or boards that Science can print as high-value provided they bring forth justification to such measures.
3. Combat Mechs need an Authorization form filled and stamped by an appropriate head of staff before construction.
4. Violations of Corporate Law using these items from sections 1 through 3 may result in charges against the science department.
5. Science should focus on the deployment of upgrades. Examples would include: Cells to Medical/Security, Flatpacks to their respective departments, etc
